note: Held out. Two producer-worded questions per note, 75 notes, 150 cases, written 2026-09-30 by reading only the indexed text of each note. Each case names the note it was written from; where a manual chapter was split into -pt1/-pt2/-pt3 parts that say the same thing, every part in that family counts (source_any_include), because the part boundary is ours and not the producer's. 59 of the 75 notes are ones no tuned fixture asks about; the other 16 are shared, and the closest question here to any tuned question is 0.40 word-overlap. This file replaces device_purpose_sealed_qwen8b.json as the holdout: that set was already scored four times to choose between wordings (none 0.338 / drafted 0.417 / sharper 0.386 / both 0.447, North Star 26-28 Sept) and its own note now reads 'Now development data', so no half of it is still sealed.
policy: Tuned on: never. No change to note wording, index, embedding model or ranking is chosen by looking at these questions.
Scored with tooling/scripts/evaluate_retrieval_modes.py at gate time only, and the receipt is filed with the result.
tooling/scripts/sealed_fixtures.py refuses this file for any tuning path, so pointing one at it raises rather than printing a number.
A tuning run that leaks here retires the holdout: fix the leak, then author a fresh set of the same size.
build_brain_style_corpus.py still reads this file, on purpose: it drops near-copies of every eval question out of training material.
